name: Dokumamushi Kisuke
source: Rape, murder, robbery, trespassing, and abandonment of a corpse. For his repeated heinous crimes, he was sentenced to death. Onisuke was transferred from the Kanto Detention Center to another detention center. Onisuke took advantage of a police officer's mistake, stole a gun, and escaped.
translation: Rape, murder, robbery, trespassing, and abandonment of a corpse. For his repeated heinous crimes, he was sentenced to death.
